title: Semantic Communities and Boundary-Spanning Lyrics in K-pop: A Graph-Based Unsupervised Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2602.12881v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We examine how lyric representation shapes computational similarity using four 384-dimensional multilingual MiniLM representations of 7,891 K-pop songs by 1,456 artists from charts spanning 2000 to October 2023. Whole-song truncated embeddings provide the strongest standardized separation between neighbouring and random song pairs (1.995), compared with 1.931 for chunked documents, although chunked representations show greater adjusted Rand agreement and line-based representations yield higher modularity. Using whole-song embeddings, we construct a weighted cosine nearest-neighbour graph ($k=30$). A representative Louvain partition identifies 21 operational communities, without a corresponding robust plateau in the Markov Stability analysis. translated_title: 韩流音乐（K-pop）中的语义社群与跨边界歌词：一种基于图的无监督分析
translated_abstract: 我们研究了歌词表示方式如何影响计算相似度，使用了四种384维的多语言MiniLM表示方法，对象涵盖2000年至2023年10月排行榜中1,456位艺术家的7,891首K-pop歌曲。整首歌截断嵌入在相邻歌曲对与随机歌曲对之间提供了最强的标准化区分度（1.995），相比之下分块文档为1.931，尽管分块表示显示出更高的调整兰德指数一致性，而基于行的表示则产生更高的模块度。利用整首歌嵌入，我们构建了一个加权余弦最近邻图（k=30）。代表性的Louvain划分识别出21个操作性社群，但马尔可夫稳定性分析中并未出现相应的稳健平台期。对选定歌词和术语的AI辅助分析表明，歌词中存在记忆、分离、渴望、自我反思、吸引与表演等重叠的主题模式。社群成员关系与...
tldr: 该研究利用多语言MiniLM嵌入对7,891首K-pop歌曲构建加权最近邻图并通过Louvain算法识别出21个语义社群，发现整首歌嵌入提供最佳的相邻歌曲区分度，且歌词主题呈现记忆、分离、渴望等跨社群的重叠模式。
